name: @activepieces/piece-retable
description: Turn your spreadsheets into smart database apps

auth.description:
To obtain your API key, follow these steps:

1. Go to Account Overview by clicking your profile-pic (top-right).
2. Go to API section and enable API key.
3. Copy API key.

retable_create_record.name: retable_create_record
retable_create_record.description: Adds a record into a retable

aiMetadata.description: Appends a new row to a Retable table, mapping the supplied column values into a single record. Use to write data into a specific retable; requires the workspace, project, and retable identifiers plus the field values (empty cell values are skipped). Not idempotent — each call inserts another record.

Lists all Retable workspaces accessible with the connected API key. Use as the entry point to discover workspace IDs needed by project, retable, and record actions. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

retable_get_projects.name: retable_get_projects
retable_get_projects.description: Gets all projects in given workspace

aiMetadata.description: Lists all projects within a given Retable workspace. Use to discover project IDs after selecting a workspace, before fetching retables or records. Requires the workspace ID; read-only and idempotent.

retable_get_retables.name: retable_get_retables
retable_get_retables.description: Gets all retables in given project

aiMetadata.description: Lists all retables (tables) within a given Retable project. Use to discover retable IDs needed before reading or writing records. Requires the project ID; read-only and idempotent.

Creates a new top-level Retable workspace with the given name and optional description. Use when an agent needs a fresh workspace to organize projects under. Not idempotent — each call creates another workspace, even with the same name.

retable_create_project.name: retable_create_project
retable_create_project.description: Creates a project in the given workspace

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new project inside an existing Retable workspace, with a name and optional description and color. Use to set up a project container for retables; requires the target workspace ID. Not idempotent — each call creates another project.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
